answer: Pay rewards per funding cluster, not per key. Trace each key's first deposit back through the transfer graph, like water through karst, and group keys whose funds drain from one canyon of common sources. A cluster earns the square root of its members' summed scores, so splitting one budget into N keys adds almost nothing while each key still owes a bond and full grading work. A zephyr of fresh keys with no traceable history starts at a tiny cap that only grows with independently funded, sustained work.
